title: Exosky
description:
The Story In a future where humanity has colonized the solar system, you join Norton - an AI entity manifested as a cat - on a mission to create the ultimate autopilot. Your daring maneuvers become training data for safeguarding future pilots, all while exploring worlds that blur the line between technology and imagination.

Core Experience• Score points through dangerous flying - the riskier the stunt, the higher the score

• Master realistic flight physics that account for each aircraft's unique properties

• Explore semi-procedurally generated courses across technological dreamscapes

Key Features• 11 unique aircraft with distinct flight characteristics

• 8 surreal levels inspired by computer components (fly through flooded motherboards and sound cards on a moon!)

• Full modding support with detailed flight model documentation

• Encounters with fantastical creatures and dangerous hazards.

Technical Details• Single player

• Solo developed by a licensed pilot

• Full controller & joystick support

• Detailed modding & flight model documentation available at exosky.aero
description_short: Master the art of extreme flight in Exosky, a surreal, physics-based sim where risky stunts means higher scores and better data. Push the limits of airframe and pilot as you train an AI cat's revolutionary autopilot system. Try the demo now!
